name: Multi-channel for WooCommerce
author: miniOrange

sections.description:
Multi-channel for WooCommerce allows you to connect your WooCommerce store to Amazon easily, enabling you to manage products, inventory, and orders in real time across both platforms.

Sync your WooCommerce store product with Amazon to ensure accurate stock levels, automate order syncing, and manage listings without the need for manual updates.

Features

  • Real-time product and inventory sync between WooCommerce and Amazon.
  • Bulk product uploads and automatic listing.
  • Map WooCommerce product fields to Amazon’s product fields.
  • Sync Amazon orders into WooCommerce automatically.
  • Audit logs for troubleshooting and monitoring.

Use Case

  • Multi-Channel Retailer Expanding to Amazon
    You are running a WooCommerce store and currently selling through your online store, but want to expand to Amazon to increase your reach. With WooCommerce Amazon Integration, you can easily automate product sync by mapping your product fields from WooCommerce (like SKU, price, description) to Amazon’s required fields. You can use the bulk upload feature to list all your products on Amazon in a few clicks.

  • Inventory Sync: As products are sold on either WooCommerce or Amazon, the plugin ensures that inventory is updated on both platforms to avoid overselling with a single click of a button.

  • Order Sync: Your Amazon orders are automatically synced into WooCommerce, where you can manage them just like your regular WooCommerce orders. No manual work is required to import Amazon sales.

Outcome: You can now sell on Amazon without worrying about inventory discrepancies, and you can manage orders and products from a single dashboard, saving your time and preventing errors.

Upcoming Integrations

  • connect WooCommerce with eBay – Connect with an eBay seller account to manage products and orders from WooCommerce
  • connect WooCommerce with Walmart – Connect with a Walmart seller account to manage products and orders from WooCommerce
  • connect WooCommerce with Etsy – Connect with an Etsy seller account to manage products and orders from WooCommerce

Requirements

  • WooCommerce: Version 3.0 or higher.
  • WordPress: Version 6.0 or higher.
  • Access to Amazon Seller Account

External services

This plugin enables users to list products from WooCommerce on their Amazon seller account by securely connecting to Amazon’s public APIs, and can also securely fetch Amazon orders from the authorised seller account to WooCommerce.
Below are the services this plugin utilises-

  • Amazon Seller: The Following external services are used to connect to the Amazon Seller account securely:

    https://sellingpartnerapi-na.amazon.com
    https://sellingpartnerapi-eu.amazon.com
    https://sellingpartnerapi-fe.amazon.com
    https://sellercentral.amazon.com
    https://sellercentral.amazon.ca
    https://sellercentral.amazon.com.mx
    https://sellercentral.amazon.com.br
    https://sellercentral.amazon.ie
    https://sellercentral-europe.amazon.com
    https://sellercentral.amazon.com.be
    https://sellercentral.amazon.nl
    https://sellercentral.amazon.se
    https://sellercentral.amazon.co.za
    https://sellercentral.amazon.pl
    https://sellercentral.amazon.eg
    https://sellercentral.amazon.com.tr
    https://sellercentral.amazon.sa
    https://sellercentral.amazon.ae
    https://sellercentral.amazon.in
    https://sellercentral.amazon.sg
    https://sellercentral.amazon.com.au
    https://sellercentral.amazon.co.jp

    Terms of Use and Privacy Policy of the above services provided by Amazon Seller and Selling API services used in the plugin are as follows:

    Amazon Seller Terms of Use
    Amazon Seller Privacy Policy

  • Xecurify (miniOrange) – This plugin also uses our service (miniOrange/xecurify.com) to authorise users to connect to their Amazon seller account securely, as well as an option to register with miniOrange, which is entirely optional. During this process, no data is stored on our end. All the data remains on the user’s end only. The following services are used in the plugin:

    https://login.xecurify.com
    https://multichannel-connect.xecurify.com

    Terms of Use and Privacy Policy of the above Xecurify.com (miniOrange) services used in the plugin are as follows:

    miniOrange (Xecurify) Terms of Use
    miniOrange (Xecurify) Privacy Policy

Important Notes

  • This plugin does not rely directly on Amazon to work; users can choose to securely connect to their Amazon seller account to manage the products and orders.
  • Additionally, the plugin may connect to login.xecurify.com (whose terms of use and privacy policy are provided above) if a user opts to register with miniOrange (our service). This is entirely optional.

Privacy

This plugin does not store any user data.

Support

If you need assistance, visit our support page at https://plugins.miniorange.com/woocommerce-amazon-integration, or contact us via email at apisupport@xecurify.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the multi-channel-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Connect your Amazon seller account and configure settings through the WooCommerce settings page.
  4. Begin syncing your products, inventory, and orders between WooCommerce and Amazon!
sections.faq:
What is the WooCommerce Amazon Integration Plugin?

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to Amazon, allowing you to sync your inventory, product listings, and orders between the two platforms. It eliminates the need for manual updates, ensuring accurate stock levels.

Does the plugin support automatic order syncing from Amazon to WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin automatically syncs Amazon orders to WooCommerce, including order details like items, quantities, price, fulfilment channel (FBA/FBM), and more. Amazon order numbers are used as WooCommerce order IDs.

Do I need technical skills to use the plugin?

No, the plugin is designed with a user-friendly interface, so you can easily configure and manage your integration without any coding knowledge.
